planets.name: TOI-1680 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1680 with a 4.8-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-1680 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1680. Its orbit and size follow Ghachoui et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
